fieldNotes.site: Positively identified as 6509 Kimball Avenue, Chino CA - the roof number '6509' is legible on the west building's roof in z20 satellite imagery. Cross-dock Class-A Inland Empire warehouse in the dense Chino logistics district south of Kimball Avenue.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yards on both the west and east faces are enclosed by chain-link fencing (visible in Street View off Kimball Avenue and around the perimeter). Two truck entrances: the east truck corridor off Kimball Avenue (shared drive between this building and the solar-roofed building east) and a SW perimeter-road drive into the west drop yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard-booth structure visible at any entrance in Street View. Modern multi-tenant IE spec building - access consistent with sliding/cantilever gate plus kiosk/intercom (remote check-in).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building - distinct dock banks on the west face and the east face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock: roughly 50-55 doors on the west face and 50-55 on the east face; estimated total ~105 (50+ band).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked without tractors in the west drop yard alongside stacked materials; estimated 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck corridor and deep aprons on both faces leave room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two truck access points - east corridor and SW drive.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~25.5 acres for the 6509 parcel including building, west drop yard and east corridor.
